newsitem.title: USA: Rouge Steel board approves furnace upgrade.
newsitem.headline: Rouge Steel board approves furnace upgrade.

text.p: Rouge Steel Co said Friday that its board on Thursday approved a $36 million expenditure for the full reline of its "B" blast furnace, including major ancillary equipment improvements.

The reline is tentatively scheduled to start in September and the furnace is expected to be out of service for 70 to 80 days. By the time of the reline, "B" furnace will have produced approximately 6.6 million tons of hot metal over its nine-year campaign.
The furnace improvements are expected to increase the campaign life of the furnace to 10 years and improve its productive output during the campaign by more than 50 percent.
Rouge Steel is continuing its slab purchase program for 1997 to provide an uninterrupted supply of steel to its customers in anticipation of the planned outage of "B" furnace, the company said.
Rouge Steel, a fully integrated producer of flat rolled sheet steel, principally serves the automotive, converter and service center markets.
